raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 8
Reason for Mistake: The Planner shifted the target answer from the widely recognized establishment date (11 February 1929, when the Lateran Treaty was signed) to 7 June 1929 (the ratification/entry-into-force date) as “the independence date” without proper justification. This conflated legal ratification with the commonly cited “became its own country” date, introduced inconsistency with earlier steps, and led to confirmation-biased, redundant searches aimed at validating 7 June instead of synthesizing the already sufficient evidence for 11 February 1929.
